claims.statement: Chen and Koo's 2013 Theorem 10(i) gives a prime-factor criterion for splitting 3/m into two distinct positive unit fractions, gcd(m,3)=1.
claims.audit: Theorem statement read; full proof not audited.

claims.statement: All prime factors of ((t-1)/2)^2+((t-1)/2)+1 are 1 modulo 3 for any integer t≡1 modulo 6.
For every positive t divisible by 7 with each prime divisor 1 modulo 3, letting n=t², the least x in a strict unit-fraction triple for 4/n is D(n)=(n+7)/4.
